title: System Notifications — Create / Edit
overviewHtml: A reminder the system sends on a schedule, recognised by its Notification Name: BIRTHDAY_NOTIFICATION, ANNIVERSARY_NOTIFICATION, AdvancePayment_NOTIFICATION, LEAVERESUMPTION_NOTIFICATION, PUNCHDURINGLEAVE_NOTIFICATION and ANNUALLEAVEMAXLIMITREACHED_NOTIFICATION. A name the system does not recognise does nothing.

fields.label: NotificationName
fields.html:
What it is. Which reminder this is, as the system names it.

Example. LEAVERESUMPTION_NOTIFICATION

Why it matters. Must match one of the names above exactly.

fields.label: NotificationConfig
fields.rules: Required. Chosen from Notification Config master data.
fields.html: What it is. The notification configuration — template and recipients — the reminder is sent with.

fields.label: ReminderDays
fields.html:
What it is. How many days ahead the reminder is sent.

Example. 3

Why it matters. Used by the advance-payment reminder: it goes out this many days before the leave start or payment date, as set in Notification Settings.

fields.label: IsActive
fields.html:
What it is. Whether the reminder is sent.

Why it matters. Unticked, the reminder is not sent.
